item.title: Katy Church holds Thanksgiving turkey giveaway
item.description: Higher Dimension Church held its second annual Turkey Giveaway Nov. 23 at its Katy campus, 1350 N. Mason Road.

item.title: Judge orders psychological exam for woman accused of killing Katy lounge owner
item.description: A judge ordered a psychological examination for a woman accused of fatally shooting a Katy hookah lounge owner, and set her bond at $250,000 during a court appearance Tuesday. The examination is designed to determine if she has mental illness or....

item.title: Congressman Troy Nehls won't seek reelection – Endorses his brother
item.description: U.S. Rep. Troy Nehls, R-Texas, announced Friday he will not seek reelection after his current term ends, marking the conclusion of a career spanning more than three decades in law enforcement and military service.

item.title: Fort Bend County geophysicist Rebecca Clark launches Congressional campaign after Troy Nehls exit
item.description: Fort Bend County conservative Rebecca Clark announced Saturday her candidacy for Congress in Texas' 22nd Congressional District, the same day U.S. Rep. Troy Nehls said he will not seek reelection.

item.title: Lane Closures scheduled by the Fort Bend County Toll Road Authority
item.description: These are the lane closures scheduled by the Fort Bend County Toll Road Authority for the Week of 12/01/25.

item.title: Waller County economic development leader explains how jobs, tax base build sustainable communities
item.description: Economic development serves as the foundation for sustainable communities, requiring both strong capital investment and quality jobs, according to Waller County Economic Development Partnership Executive Director Vince Yokom.

item.title: Former State Rep. Jacey Jetton announces campaign for Congress in Texas' 22nd District
item.description: Jetton, a Republican from Richmond, joins a growing field of candidates seeking to represent the district, which serves much of Fort Bend County and portions of Brazoria and Harris counties in the U.S. House of Representatives.

item.title: Former Fort Bend County Constable Trever Nehls announces bid for Congress in Texas' 22nd District
item.description: Former Fort Bend County Precinct 4 Constable Trever Nehls announced his candidacy for Congress in Texas' 22nd District, joining the race to succeed his brother, U.S. Rep. Troy Nehls, who announced on Saturday that he will not seek re-election.

item.title: Fulshear's Dozier's BBQ expands to downtown Houston food hall
item.description: Tyler Risinger, the original owner's great-grandson, leads the concept. The family reopened Dozier's in Fulshear in August 2024 after the business had closed in March under different ownership.
